description:
Telekom HBS, part of the Telekom Group, is an ICT Systems Integrator offering a comprehensive suite of ICT Solutions and Services.

Telekom HBS, specializes in delivering ICT Services in areas such as Cloud, Data Centre operations, Networking, Cybersecurity, BI and Data Warehouse, Big Data, Service Desk, Proactive Monitoring, Operations and Support, Service Management, Project and Programme Management, and Professional Services. We are seeking a Senior AI/ML & LLM Security Engineer to join our team:

  • Strong Python development skills
  • PyTorch and Hugging Face/Transformers or equivalent ML/LLM frameworks
  • Deployment and operation of open-source and commercial LLMs
  • Deployment and optimisation of local/on-premise LLMs
  • Model selection, comparison, benchmarking and evaluation
  • Fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA/QLoRA and related approaches
  • Model quantisation and inference optimisation
  • Embeddings and vector databases
  • RAG, advanced/contextual RAG and GraphRAG architectures
  • Agentic AI systems and tool-using LLMs
  • MCP and integration of LLMs with external tools and APIs
  • Evaluation frameworks, hallucination/reliability testing and model performance assessment
  • GPU-based inference and associated infrastructure
  • AI/ML pipelines and MLOps
  • Security of LLM/AI systems, including prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse, poisoning and adversarial attacks
  • AI red teaming and security testing of AI-based systems
  • Application of AI/ML to cybersecurity use cases
